heads.t: 每天喝咖啡肝癌風險降47%！35萬人研究曝 醫：還防糖尿病 每天喝咖啡不只能提神，還可能是保護肝臟的好習慣！減重醫師蕭捷健分享，一項追蹤13年、分析約35萬人的研究發現，與完全不喝咖啡的人相比，每天喝咖啡者的肝硬化風險降低32%、肝癌風險降低47%，死於肝病的風險也減少42%。值得注意的是，低咖啡因咖啡也呈現類似的保護關聯，對於喝咖啡容易心悸、影響睡眠的人來說，可能是另一種選擇。 13 分鐘前｜健康 每天喝咖啡肝癌風險降47%！35萬人研究曝 醫：還防糖尿病 13 分鐘前｜健康
heads.en: The risk of cancer of the liver is 47% less every day. 350,000 people study exposure. A study of 13 years of surveillance and analysis of about 350,000 people found that the risk of cirrhosis is 32 per cent lower for coffee drinkers per day, 47 per cent lower for liver cancer and 42 per cent lower for liver diseases than for those without coffee at all. It is worth noting that decaf is associated with similar protections, which may be another option for those who drink coffee that is prone to depression and sleep. Health 13 minutes ago, the risk of coffee and liver cancer decreased by 47% every day. 350,000 people were exposed.
